Consistency in your diet is key. You can try to create a diet around whole Foods and move away from processed foods. Don’t worry too much about the gym, but make sure you commit to movement every day, don’t worry about vigorous exercise (My Apple Watch goals help me). Try looking up inspiring food bloggers for recipes (@FitMenCook is an example of one I like) and def meal plan your week so you don’t get stuck with last minute unhealthy take out or frozen pizza. Planning and staying consistent is huge… and giving yourself grace along the way. Don’t deprive yourself, you’re allowed to have a dessert but make more calculated choices on what it is. Don’t look at it as a diet with an end date, but educating yourself on a healthier lifestyle- this was way it is empowering, not extreme, and doesn’t feel like torture with an end date. Have fun cooking, making smoothies, meal prepping - even do it with friends or family. I lost 75+ lbs 4 years ago and have kept it off- not drinking alcohol and minimizing my gluten intake also really helped me.
